Subject: Private deployment commercial — platform fee / ops credits question

Hi Soojin / Mateo,

Quick context: we finished an internal technical review of Redwood Private and are aligned on the architecture. Procurement asked me to follow up on commercial constructs — specifically how the platform fee is calculated for a VPC/on-prem deployment, and whether you can provide scaling credits (ops-band / SRE oncall credits) tied to commit length or capacity.

Two specific asks:
- Can the platform fee be capped or amortized monthly instead of an upfront charge?
- Do you have a standard credit schedule for implementation/support (we're looking for runway credits in the first 6–12 months)?

We're targeting an initial pilot (single region, ~8 nodes) with an option to scale to multi-region production later. Any quick thoughts or a one-pager you can send over before we loop Legal?

Thanks,
Tim

Hi Tim — thanks for the clear asks. Happy to outline a few practical options (summary below) and I'll attach a short commercial summary for Aurelia. Can we schedule 30 minutes tomorrow to walk through numbers?

High-level options (pilot → production):
1) Amortized platform fee: convert platform fee to a monthly amortized line over the initial commit (12 or 18 months). Maintains revenue predictability for us while lowering your upfront cash.
   - Example: 18-month amortization reduces upfront by ~83% of annual platform fee (line-item on invoice).
2) Staggered ops credits (implementation & SRE oncall): tiered credits based on commit and node count.
   - Pilot (0–12 months): one-time implementation credit (we typically offer 20–40% of platform fee as credit for pilots).
   - Production scale (after pilot): additional capacity credits (per-node) applied as invoice discounts for months where you provision >= committed capacity.
3) Support tiers & response banding: standard / enterprise / enterprise+ (SRE retainer + 24/7 oncall). We can conditionally roll top-tier SRE discounts to longer commits (>= 18 months).

I'll attach "commercial-summary-aurelia.xlsx" with two worked examples (8-node pilot, 24-node scale) and a sample amortization schedule. If Legal needs an initial SOW redline we can accept an annotated SOW and respond within 48 hours.

Proposed next steps:
- 30-min call: Fri 05/22 10:00am PT or Mon 05/25 9:00am PT
- I'll bring a concise amortization worksheet and the draft SOW template

Thanks — will follow up with the attachment and a calendar invite.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts (Private Deployments)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Aurelia credit framing & node math

Quick notes for call / response draft:
- Implementation credit: we can stretch to 30% of the first-year platform fee for a pilot that converts within 6 months; 20% if conversion >6 and <12 months.
- Amortization mechanics: prefer 18-month amortization for platform fee for accounting hygiene; 12 months ok if procurement pushes.
- Ops-band credits: define as $/node-month credits (easier to apply as invoice credit). Example: $350/node-month credit for months 1–6 for first 8 nodes = ~$16.8k credit total.
- SRE retainer: can discount first 3 months 100% and 6 months at 50% if commit >= 18 months. If commit 12 months, we'll do first 2 months 100% then 4 months 25%

Risk callouts:
- Deep discounts on platform fee + large oncall credits reduce our ability to fund the private control plane roadmap. Need a floor.
- Legal will want mileage for exit cap and escrow on license — expect negotiation.

I'll be on the call tomorrow. I'll bring a short table of options to pick from.

-Mateo

Proposed response for Aurelia (we should present in writing):
- Accept 18-month commit trade: 30% implementation credit (applied as invoice credit month 1) + first 3 months SRE retainer waived.
- Amortize remaining platform fee over 18 months with an explicit cap for year 1 (example cap = annualized platform fee * 1.05 for pilot variance).
- Credits are usage-contingent: credits apply only to provisioned nodes; if they scale down we prorate credits back against the invoice period (protects us).
- SOW: attach redlined SOW that keeps IP/license language standard and adds an exit-cap clause (we offer migration assistance up to X hours, beyond that billable).

I've attached Aurelia-legal-redlines.pdf and redlined-sow.docx for review. If everyone signs off, Soojin — send the package to Tim + procurement and include the DocuSign envelope link.

-Priyom

Confirmed commercial construct (summary):
- Commit term: 18 months (pilot conversion triggers production pricing).
- Implementation credit: 30% of year-1 platform fee applied as invoice credit in month 1.
- SRE retainer: first 3 months waived (SRE access and oncall included) then standard retainer thereafter.
- Platform fee amortization: remaining platform fee amortized monthly over 18 months. Year-1 cap: we will cap total platform fee exposure to your finance team at Annualized_Platform_Fee * 1.05 (example numbers in attached spreadsheet).
- Credits applicability: credits are usage-contingent and prorated if provisioned node-count drops below committed capacity in a billing period.
- Legal & SOW: attached redlined SOW + legal notes. We kept Redwood IP/license standard; added a migration-assistance clause (X hours) and an exit cap for clarity.
